content: STAGE 1 — goal: fix the design constraint before proposing. Read: the round-three brief (R1 0.05439 with L3=2201; R2 0.05165 with L3=1298; frozen baseline ~0.0679; gate 0.065), the scope contract, the five binding experiment-policy clauses, and the list of already-tried mechanisms from rounds 20261028/29 (poincare-frechet-successor-codebook, CURVCTRL-SID, BRad-RQ, behcone-prefix-rq, succboost-geoshift, LORENTZ-SUCCPROFILE-SMOOTH-RQ, MIXCURV-FIBRE-RQ, BRANCHCURV-MOEB-RQ, TSG-SID). Observation: 24556 train items / 1251 distinct L2 pairs = 19.6 items per L2 cell, but only 1298 distinct L3 triples => ~1.04 L3 codes per L2 cell. The third RQ level is doing essentially no work; round one (1.76 codes/cell, 2201 triples) scored higher than round two (1.04, 1298). Reasoning: the recall lever is the number of distinct deep codes per level-2 cell, not codeword count or radial position; any mechanism that reduces it (hub attraction, prefix merging) loses. Still open: which coupling position raises deep-level splits without a tuned temperature.

STAGE 2 — goal: test whether the obvious 'shell / radius-normalisation' idea is geometrically vacuous. Read: nothing external; derived the Poincare distance identity d_P(x,y)=arcosh(1+2c||x-y||^2/((1-c||x||^2)(1-c||y||^2))). Observation: if all deep codewords sit on one sphere of radius rho and items are also placed at fixed radius, then d_P is a strictly monotone function of cos(theta), so the hard argmin equals the Euclidean/cosine argmin and a curvature-off arm would be indistinguishable from curvature-on. Correction recorded: any proposal whose only curved operation is a shell projection or a fixed-radius lattice is a gauge no-op for the SID tokens and must be rejected. Reasoning: curvature must enter through (a) heterogeneous radii, or (b) non-commutative ball algebra (Mobius gyro-operations), or (c) a curved loss that changes the encoder, not through a monotone reparametrisation. Open: choose the algebraic route, which is knob-free.

STAGE 3 — goal: settle the mechanism and check it against policy. Read: the round's open-hyperparameter note (level count / codebook size are Stage-2 architecture, allowed if coupled in one path and cost stays near 0.15 s/epoch). Observation: (i) tangent-space residual subtraction r^{l+1}=r^l-log_0(c_l) is what makes deep residuals shrink to zero, so level 3 collapses; (ii) Mobius gyro-subtraction r^l = r^{l-1} (-) c_l with reconstruction defined as the gyro-sum c_1(+)(c_2)(+)(c_3) is exactly consistent by gyro-cancellation, adds no constant, and keeps residuals at a curvature-determined scale; (iii) behaviour enters as a per-pair multiplier on the Poincare distance, (1 - a_ik), which is non-monotone and therefore genuinely changes the argmin and hence the tokens. Chosen: GYRO-BEHAFF-SID, deep codebooks 512 at levels 2 and 3, gamma=1 (scale-free because a in [0,1]). Estimated cost: +10-15% of the quantizer stage, ~0.17 s/epoch, ~1 GFLOP/step extra for the affinity matmul at batch 4096 x 256 x 512. Open: none blocking; writing the final block.

STAGE 4 — FINAL ANSWER (complete, self-contained).
IDEA: GYRO-BEHAFF-SID. Mobius-gyro residual RQ with behaviour-affinity-weighted Poincare deep assignment; 3 levels, K=(256,512,512). One both-on training run only; behaviour-off (gamma=0) and geometry-off (tangent subtraction + Euclidean distance) switches exist and are wired but untrained. Predicted observables: L3 triples from 1298 to >=3000, L3 codes per L2 cell from 1.04 to >=2.5, behaviour purity of L3 codes >0.3, d_P reconstruction within 5% of baseline, then Stage3 test_recall@10 judged against 0.065. Full specification, equations, safeguards, cost and leakage boundary are in the printed answer block.

STAGE: design decision for the single "one more idea" (ideation_1, round three).
GOAL: choose a coupling position that the earlier rounds did not occupy and that does not repeat the two negative results.
READ: the round briefing text in my prompt (no repository files were readable: read/glob into ideas.txt, progress.jsonl were permission-denied; I therefore reasoned from the brief's measured numbers only).
OBSERVED (evidence location: brief, "WHAT ROUNDS ONE AND TWO MEASURED" and "THE ONE CONSISTENT SIGNAL"): round one 251/1769/2201 prefixes -> recall 0.05439; round two 230/1251/1298 prefixes -> 0.05165; frozen baseline 0.0679. Every mechanism that merged prefixes lost recall. Behaviour-CONTRAST metrics predict recall (+0.7104) while Gromov-delta and ancestor-depth weighting hurt. Curvature is a gauge. Objectives minimised at the ball origin collapse the encoder.
REASONING: the only unused direction consistent with all four facts is an outward, hinge-bounded, behaviour-CONTRAST (repulsive) operator applied to the QUANTISED codeword vectors at the deepest levels, so (i) it cannot merge prefixes, (ii) it cannot collapse to the origin because its minimum is at distance >= margin, (iii) the behaviour signal reaches the tokens through the straight-through path into the level-3/4 codebooks, (iv) curvature is fixed at c=1 and used only through the radial distortion of the Poincare metric, which sidesteps the gauge objection. Combined with one extra RQ level (capacity the brief explicitly declares legal), the partition can only get finer at depth.
STILL OPEN: nothing further to measure here; the answer block follows as its own record.

STAGE: final answer (complete idea block) for ideation_1, round three.
IDEA: CGREP-4L-RQ -- Contrast-weighted geodesic repulsion on quantised codewords, with a fourth RQ level.
SUMMARY: training-only directed-transition contrast c_ij weights a hinge on Poincare distance between the QUANTISED code vectors of text-nearest item pairs, so behaviourally dissimilar but textually close items are pushed apart along the curved metric; gradient flows straight-through into the level-1..4 codebooks and a fourth 256-codeword level gives the finer partition room. Fixed curvature c=1; margin = median initial pair distance; loss weight = initial quantisation-loss / initial push-loss. Estimated +3-8% on the 0.15 s/epoch Stage-2 budget.
DIFFERENCE FROM PRIOR ROUNDS: not attraction to a successor barycentre (round two), not Frechet codebook updates, not per-level curvature control, not radial-position-from-entropy, not Gromov-delta weighting; it is the only proposal here that is repulsive and hinge-bounded, and the only one that pairs it with extra deep capacity.
FINAL JUDGEMENT IT IS AIMING AT: Stage3 test_recall@10 > 0.065 from one frozen four-GPU Stage-2 run and one frozen Stage-3 run, with no ablation arm trained.
EVIDENCE: the four measured facts quoted in the round brief (prefix counts vs recall for rounds one and two, behaviour-contrast predictive rho, gauge note, origin-collapse note).
OPEN: implementation and the single run; nothing else pending in this ideation step.
